scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the hero section renders correctly with headline, tagline, and call-to-action buttons for non-authenticated visitors

steps.description: Load the homepage at the root URL path
Check that the hero section is visible and contains expected elements
Confirm headline text is present with gradient text effect styling
Check that 'Get Started' and 'Login' buttons are visible and clickable

test_cases.expected: Hero section displays with headline, tagline, and 'Get Started' / 'Login' CTA buttons
Headline has gradient text effect classes (from-blue-600 via-purple-600 to-pink-600)

test_cases.input: Check hero section animation on load
test_cases.expected: Framer Motion animations are applied and hero content animates into view

scenarios.name: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the features section showcases product capabilities with feature cards containing icons, titles, and descriptions

steps.description: Load the homepage and scroll past the hero section
Scroll down to reveal the features section
Check that feature cards are displayed with icons, titles, and descriptions
Confirm cards animate into view with staggered timing

test_cases.expected: Feature cards for URL shortening, analytics, and dashboard are displayed
Each card contains a Lucide icon, title text, and description text
Card displays hover effect with neon glow styling
Feature cards use GlassMorphismCard component with blur and transparency

scenarios.name: Navigation to Registration
scenarios.description: Verify that non-authenticated visitors can navigate to the registration page via CTA buttons

steps.description: Navigate to homepage without authentication
Click the primary CTA button in the hero section
Confirm user is redirected to registration page

test_cases.input: Click 'Get Started' button as unauthenticated user
test_cases.expected: User is navigated to /register page
User is navigated to /login page
CTA buttons are rendered using FuturisticButton component

scenarios.name: Authenticated User Dashboard Navigation
scenarios.description: Verify that authenticated users see 'Go to Dashboard' CTA and can navigate to their dashboard

steps.description: Authenticate user and load the homepage
Check that primary CTA shows 'Go to Dashboard' instead of 'Get Started'
Click the dashboard CTA button
Confirm user is redirected to /dashboard

test_cases.expected: Primary CTA displays 'Go to Dashboard' text
User is navigated to /dashboard route
Component correctly reads authentication state from AuthContext

test_cases.expected: All text elements meet WCAG AA contrast ratio (4.5:1 for normal text)
Homepage components correctly consume theme from ThemeContext

test_cases.input: Toggle between light and dark modes
test_cases.expected: Theme transitions smoothly without layout shifts
